narr: A low pressure system with multiple embedded disturbances moved across Arizona with scattered showers and thunderstorms. Some of these storms produced heavy rain and flash flooding.
ev: Jacks Canyon Creek near Winslow rose 2.8 feet in 90 minutes from 2.2 feet to 5 feet at 945 AM.
Heavy rain caused Dry Beaver Creek to rise 3.6 feet in 30 minutes cresting at 1215 PM.
A 3.9 foot rise was recorded on the Agua Fria River (AFMA3) east of Cordes Junction.
Kaibab National Forest reported that flooding closed Forest Road 22 from Forest Road 422A to Big Springs.
lsr: JACKS CANYON CREEK RIVER GAUGE NEAR WINSLOW ROSE 2.8 FEET IN 1 HOUR AND 30 MINUTES FROM BASELINE FLOW OF 2.2 FEET TO 5 FEET AT 9:45AM MST.
